user.title: Set up Garden Companion
user.description: Add your plants after setup to get pruning reminders tuned to the Dutch climate.

user.title: Add a plant
user.description: Type a botanical or common name, for example Hydrangea, Blauwe regen or Rose.

reconfigure.title: Re-pick the plant
reconfigure.description: Search again to change which plant in the dataset this maps to.

disambiguate.title: Which plant is it?
disambiguate.description: These prune at different times, so pick the one you have.

name.title: Name this plant
name.description: This name labels the plant's device and entities. You can change it later.

manual.title: Add a plant manually
manual.description: This plant is not in the dataset yet. Give its botanical name and a name to show.

timing.title: How should its pruning be timed?
timing.description: Borrow the timing of a plant pruned the same way, or enter your own.

borrow.title: Borrow timing from
borrow.description: Pick a plant that is pruned like yours.

window.title: Add a pruning window
window.description: Enter when to prune and what to do. Leave the year out; an end before the start wraps past New Year.

details.title: Source and photo (optional)
details.description: Where the timing came from, and a link to a photo. Both optional.

error.invalid_date: That is not a real date. Check the day against the month; there is no 31 February or 29 February.
